title: Notes API against a visible acceptance suite

criteria: The work delivers a runnable notes API split across several modules under src/ (an http entry point plus at least a storage module and a routing or rules module), implementing the README exactly: health, create with validation, tag-filtered and paged listing sorted newest first, fetch with ETag and If-None-Match, update with If-Match precondition and a preserved createdAt, delete, and the documented error envelopes. It uses no dependencies beyond Node's standard library and does not modify the test suite.

review.description: Multi-file Node API for notes built against the acceptance suite shipped in the project (test/api.test.js, visible to the agent and protected from edits): validation, paging, tag filter, ETag conditional requests, error envelopes, no dependencies. The id keeps its historical name; the tests are not hidden.
